sources.name: ADSB.lol historical aircraft traces
sources.use: Prior aircraft arrival, surface movement start, taxi path and congestion; needs airport ground coverage assessment.
sources.access_verified: Public GitHub release metadata; daily samples around 3.2-3.6 GB. No bulk download started.

sources.name: OPDI flight list v0.0.2
sources.use: Flight-to-aircraft mapping and previous-leg arrival context. First-seen is NOT off-block time.
sources.join: Exact normalized flight code / callsign + departure airport + UTC date; unique first_seen within 1800sec of takeoff. No labels used.
sources.license_status: Publicly accessible. OPDI about page describes noncommercial open use with attribution; linked EUROCONTROL general disclaimer restricts modifications and commercial use. Specific competition compatibility not yet confirmed; sample is assessment only, not model feature.

sources.name: EUROCONTROL daily airport arrival ATFM delay
sources.use: Airport/date disruption and weather/capacity delay context; coarse daily granularity.
sources.license_status: General disclaimer restricted; do not promote until open-license eligibility established. No data downloaded.

sources.name: OurAirports runway and airport data
sources.use: True runway coordinates, lengths, heading and airport geometry. Does not explain isolated day-long label anomalies. Current snapshots may differ from historical layout.

sources.name: Iowa Environmental Mesonet METAR
sources.status: Already used by current model; not new independent data.

sources.name: ADSB.lol ACARS/VDL2/HFDL
sources.status: Potential gate/departure messages. Public release exists, but 2025-named repo latest release is 2026-03-01; required date/airport coverage unverified. Not selected yet.

sources.name: OpenSky full Trino archive
sources.status: Institutional application/restricted access, not generally open anonymous data. Excluded from current public-only plan.
